dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open problem on sublinear round complexity
dossier_meta.statement_text: It remains interesting to obtain a bound on the round complexity that is sublinear in $n$ regardless of the value of $d$.
dossier_meta.context_text: After noting that network decompositions can replace the $O(d^4 \log^3 n)$ round complexity of Theorem 1.3 by $d^3 2^{O(\sqrt{\log n})}$, the authors remark that these alternative bounds are unsatisfying. The problem of achieving a round complexity that is sublinear in $n$ independent of $d$ remains open.
